# What does this adjunct course really pay per hour?

> Free adjunct pay calculator: enter the per-course pay, prep, grading, unpaid office hours, commute and cancellation risk to see what a course really pays per hour, compare up to three offers and find the largest class worth accepting. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
